description: Extract metadata embedded in an image at the given URL: EXIF (camera, timestamps, GPS, etc.) plus IPTC and XMP rights fields (copyright notice, creator, credit line, source, usage terms, licensor) when present. Also returns exif_copyrighted / exif_copyrightHolder, which check EXIF Copyright/Artist first and fall back to the IPTC/XMP fields. Useful for finding who claims ownership of an image. Consumes account credits.

url.description: Publicly accessible image URL to analyze (http/https), e.g. https://example.com/photo.jpg

name: picdefense_extract_exif
